stem: What is a DIFFERENCE between the author's message in the story “Tasha’s Hat” and the article “Crochet Away!”?

options.label: A
options.text: In the story “Tasha’s Hat,” the message is that people need the help of family, but in the article “Crochet Away!,” the message is that people can reach their goals alone.

options.label: B
options.text: In the story “Tasha’s Hat,” the message is that decisions while shopping in person can be made quickly, but in the article “Crochet Away!,” the message is that shopping online can allow shoppers to be more thoughtful.

options.label: C
options.text: In the story “Tasha’s Hat,” the message is that planning takes time, but in the article “Crochet Away!,” the message is that planning takes hard work.

options.label: D
options.text: In the story “Tasha’s Hat,” the message is that sometimes people work in order to afford what they want, but in the article “Crochet Away!,” the message is that work can sometimes be what someone enjoys doing.
